ttsEngine.title: TTS pronunciation engine
ttsEngine.description: Speech synthesis backend: auto prefers Edge/Youdao/Google for short words and falls back cleanly to browser speech synthesis.

ttsAccent.title: English accent
ttsAccent.description: Preferred English pronunciation accent for Edge, Azure, Youdao, and Google TTS.

edgeVoice.title: Edge TTS voice
edgeVoice.description: Neural voice used when TTS engine is set to edge (or auto picks automatically by language/accent).

azureSpeechRegion.title: Azure Speech region
azureSpeechRegion.description: Azure Cognitive Services Speech region (e.g. eastus, westus2, japaneast) used with azure-speech-api-key secret.

azureSpeechVoice.title: Azure Speech voice
azureSpeechVoice.description: Optional explicit Azure Neural voice name (e.g. en-US-JennyNeural) or auto by language.

openaiTtsBaseUrl.title: OpenAI TTS base URL (optional)
openaiTtsBaseUrl.description: Optional base URL before /audio/speech. Leave empty to reuse openaiBaseUrl; configure optional openai-tts-api-key secret if using a different provider.

openaiTtsModel.title: OpenAI TTS model
openaiTtsModel.description: Model used when TTS engine is set to openai.

openaiTtsVoice.title: OpenAI TTS voice
openaiTtsVoice.description: Voice preset used when TTS engine is set to openai.

openaiTtsInstructions.title: OpenAI TTS style instructions
openaiTtsInstructions.description: Optional natural-language speaking style instructions (supported by gpt-4o-mini-tts).

ttsAutoPlay.title: Auto-play pronunciation after translating short words
ttsAutoPlay.description: Automatically speak single-word or short-phrase translations inside the Translation panel.
